problem:
Construct the matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T$ that acts on a vector in ${R}^{2}$ as follows (in the order given):

- it shears the vector by a shear factor of $\frac{1}{3}$ parallel to the $x$-axis, and then

- scales the result by a scale factor of $3$ with center of enlargement at the origin.

|  |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $T=\,\,$ |  |  |  |  |
|  |  | $0$ | {{field-3}} |  |
worked_solution:
Let $P$ be the matrix that represents the shear, and let $Q$ be the matrix that represents the scaling. These are given by the following elementary transformation matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}P & =[\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\ Q & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the combined transformation can be represented by the matrix $QP:$

$$
\begin{aligned}T & =QP \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
